entities.name: Marcello Corvani
entities.description: An elite Navy scout known for his immense strength and lack of fear who later became an ECAP operative.
entities.quote: Before he became the cold, one-eyed spy you know today... before Stitch molded him into ECAP’s most dangerous young operative... Marcello Corvani served as an elite Navy scout

timeline_events.title: The Navy Incident
timeline_events.description: Marcello Corvani dived into the ocean to clear a whale stuck in a battleship propeller using raw strength.
timeline_events.quote: He swam right into the danger, grabbed the twisted metal piece, and RIPPED IT OUT with nothing but raw human strength.
